Laura (Sales): Heads-up: Odin Corp wants a POC to validate a hybrid RAG + extractive QA over internal contracts. They've pushed back a 6-week ideal timeline and asked for DPA/SOC2/BAA info, explicit data deletion terms for POC artifacts, and a pricing quote for a short-term Dedicated pool or hosted credit.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll own technical scoping. Quick clarifications from Odin: target peak throughput ~30 QPS, median doc ~800 tokens, some documents include patient IDs (so PHI present). They want both semantic recall and an extractive answer accuracy metric.
Nina (Product): Proposed POC success criteria (draft): 1) recall@10 >= 0.8 on their labelled set; 2) extractive F1 >= 0.7; 3) hallucination rate < 5% on manual spot checks; 4) p95 end-to-end <= 500ms for retrieval+answer generation; 5) demonstrable reproducible eval notebook + comparison across Hosted vs Dedicated.
Omar (Security): Compliance checklist: signed DPA + subprocessor list; redacted SOC2 Type II report; if PHI is in scope then BAA required; encryption evidence (rest+transit) and KMS option; pen-test report summary and option to schedule a customer-scoped test. Also need data residency confirmation (EU/US) because GDPR obligations may kick in.
Chris (Customer Success): Odin requests a 14-day max retention for POC artifacts and deletion confirmation (signed attestation) after POC. Is 14 days doable? They also want an onboarding workshop and weekly demo slots.
Omar (Security): 14-day deletion is aggressive but possible for Hosted/Dedicated POCs if we scope data flow and ensure logs don't retain raw PII; we can provide a deletion attestation. Private deployments are customer's responsibility. External pen-test before granting access will require ~3 weeks to schedule.
Laura (Sales): Legal will ask for sample contract language. Omar, can you provide a DPA redline and SOC2 redacted copy this week? Also they asked whether we can do an isolated Dedicated pool locked to their account for the POC.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Dedicated isolation: yes, small GPU pool reserved; for predictability we'll recommend a 2-node minimum to avoid cold-start variance. For evaluation: ask Odin for labelled queries (they said ~5k to start) and the expected gold answers. We'll provide an evaluation harness (python) they can run.
Nina (Product): Add to success criteria: cost per query during POC must be under their internal threshold (TBD). Deliverables: onboarding runbook, eval notebook (Jupyter), config snapshot including model hash, and final report with per-route latency/cost breakdown.
Laura (Sales): Pricing ask: Odin wants either hosted credits for the POC or a time-boxed Dedicated price. Ravi, can you estimate cost for a 4-week Dedicated trial using a mid-sized model?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Tentative estimate: Dedicated 4-week -> ~$6k-$10k depending on model and utilization. Hosted credits equivalent ~ $2k-$4k for similar token volume but with variance. I'll run model-level numbers and share by Friday. Finance approval needed for any trial discount.
Chris (Customer Success): I'll coordinate onboarding and request the redacted corpus. Odin prefers an initial ingest of ~200k tokens and will provide the label CSV in CSV format. They also want an example eval prompt format.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Example eval snippet to request: ```
# odin-eval example
query,expected_doc_ids,expected_answer
"Which clause covers termination for convenience?","doc_12|doc_43","Clause 7.2: termination for convenience"
metrics: recall@10, extractive_f1, avg_latency_ms
```
Omar (Security): Note: if we enable logging for debugging we must annotate logs and ensure PII redaction. Recommend default: no raw content logged; only hashed IDs and metrics. Any request for raw logs requires security approval.
release-bot: "Reserved: odin-poc-dedicated on 2026-05-05 08:00 UTC (pending final sign-off)"
Nina (Product): Proposed timeline (condensed): Week 0: legal & artifacts (DPA/SOC2/BAA decision) + onboarding prep; Week 1: ingest + baseline run (Hosted); Week 2: Dedicated tuning; Week 3: focused eval & pen-test (if requested); Week 4: final report and handoff. If BAA/Private needed add +2 weeks.
Laura (Sales): Action items: - Omar: DPA redline + SOC2 redacted + pen-test summary by Thu. - Ravi: cost estimate Hosted vs Dedicated + runbook by Fri. - Chris: collect redacted corpus and 5k labelled queries by Tue. - Nina: produce eval notebook template and success criteria doc by Wed.
Chris (Customer Success): Odin also asked if we can sign an NDA prior to them sharing the corpus. I'll send NDA template and schedule initial workshop once executed.
Omar (Security): Will include a matrix showing what we can accept in DPA vs items requiring legal escalation (e.g., unlimited liability, forensic retention demands). Also will list minimum security controls required for Hosted POCs handling PHI.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare two config examples to show tradeoffs: 1) Hosted low-latency config (smaller beam, caching enabled), 2) Dedicated high-throughput config (quantized large model, larger batch). Attach perf knobs and expected cost ranges.
Laura (Sales): Good. If Odin insists on an external pen-test before any cloud access we need to surface the 3-week lead time. I'll patch that into the proposal.
Nina (Product): One more: include an evaluation for hallucination checks (manual sample of 200 Qs) and automated rate computation. We'll include instructions in the eval notebook.
Laura (Sales): Thanks team. I'll draft the POC proposal email and attach the ask list. Will update here after Odin responds. :raised_hands:
